geometry_changes.action: Removed 16 rooftop penthouse assembly objects across north and south towers (brick enclosure, coping, slab, four louver panels, door per tower).
geometry_changes.basis: USGS 3DEP class-1 candidate returns inside official Purdue GIS FID 57 footprint have p95 height 25.929m and max 26.161m over nearby class-2 ground; no candidate returns at/above 27m. Previous modeled top was 30.35m.
geometry_changes.limit: No class-6 building points; vertical accuracy N/A; class-1 returns may include vegetation or omit roof details. This is evidence against the modeled tall penthouse massing, not proof of exact as-built roof form.

retained_roof_geometry: North and south parapets and coping
Existing HVAC bodies and fans; their model maxima are 28.5m and are not independently verified

floors.basis: Indiana CHE 2014 and 2015 agendas describe north/south tower renovations covering floors 1–8. Existing facade has eight repeated window bands per tower.
floors.limit: Does not establish floor spacing, total elevation, penthouse/roof form, or exact correspondence of each window band to an occupied floor.

lidar_analysis.roof_return_selection: Class 1 (unclassified; this tile contains no class-6 building returns), within official FID57 polygon and >=15 m above nearby ground median. Vegetation contamination remains possible.
lidar_analysis.filter_geometry: Official GIS FID 57 polygon, transformed from EPSG:4326 using LAS-header CRS; nearby class-2 ground points from a 12 m exterior buffer used as local ground baseline.
limitations: This LAZ tile contains no class-6 building-class points; roof candidates use class-1 unclassified returns and can include vegetation.
Point cloud is from 2017-2018, not a current as-built survey.
USGS product metadata lists vertical accuracy as N/A; the height is a classified point-cloud estimate, not surveyed elevation.
Roof quantiles may include mechanical equipment; compare several quantiles and imagery before revising the modeled roof.
Ground reference uses nearby class-2 points within a 12 m buffer and may vary with local grading.

height_and_roof.interpretation: Approximate evidence, not surveyed height; classes/accuracy/time limits apply.

interior_status: No as-built floor plans or circulation evidence found; no interior geometry changed.
